title: LabSim cuvette loading Progress v1 persisted records and evaluator values
description: JSONL records are validated one object at a time. Time is episode simulation seconds. A control transition owns (t_obs,t_next]; before and after require exact physical sample matches and are null if unavailable. Reset/initial and unassigned terminal events remain in summary. Completion is causal at confirmed_t; no future result is written into earlier snapshots. Additional properties permit source metadata and compatible future diagnostics. Source episode, asset and code identities are data, not fixed constants in this schema.

metric.description: SI units: m, rad, s, N, m/s; bool and 1 are dimensionless. Missing evidence is available=false,value=null with a reason; never numeric zero.

event.description: schema is added only in progress_events.jsonl. Snapshot/summary/transition event objects retain the core event shape. Candidate events also have confirmed_t=t as their emission time; milestone confirmation is represented by the separate *_confirmed event. Event t always records emission/confirmation time, not a backdated candidate start.

stableWindow.description: Continuous duration resets when conditions, pose bounds or declared evidence cadence fail. Historical ever_achieved remains separate from current_satisfied.

compactSnapshot.description: Persisted before/after/reset snapshots omit events to prevent duplication; interval events are stored beside them.

attempt.description: One grasp interval per attempt. Legal support release ends its grip interval at end_t. A later stable completion updates outcome to success and adds stable_complete_t; past snapshots/events are not rewritten. References are rebuilt internally for each attempt; only relative-motion maxima are serialized here.

transition.description: Original collector or HDF5 alignment metadata; fields vary by online/offline source. Original actions/reward remain upstream.

summary.description: ProgressWriter.finalize output. Core stages/attempts/termination diagnosis are present when evaluator finalization succeeds; degraded writer output may omit them and reports errors. output_integrity.complete concerns sidecar integrity, not task success. original_result is preserved without relabeling. config_hash hashes resolved configuration without itself; config_sha256 hashes the complete saved configuration including config_hash.
